AllocatedNumber.description: An allocated number: the series that issued it, its sequence within the reset period, and the rendered text.

BomRequirement.description: A component requirement for a quantity of output, in the component's base unit, exact before scrap and after it.

CorrectEntryRequest.description: The replacement of an entry (its lines as a posting request; the company is the original's) and why.

CustomFieldRules.description: Type-specific rules: number range, text length and pattern, the entity type a reference points at.

Grant.description: A permission grant with the scopes it applies to (union of all assignments that grant it).

HealthReportView.description: The health payload: a status word, the applied migrations (when the database answers), an error name and each check.

InvariantReport.description: A run of the harness for one tenant (optionally one company): every check with its outcome.

InvariantResult.description: One check: what it looked at, whether it holds, and the first problems it found (never more than a page).

JobRecord.description: A stored job as the runner and the UI see it.

LedgerDrill.description: What a figure drills to: the ledger of the account over the same window with the same dimension filters.

LoginResponse.description: Login outcome: a token set, a tenant choice, an MFA challenge or an MFA enrollment requirement.

NotificationOutcome.description: How many in-app rows were written and how many emails were queued after preferences.

NumberPreview.description: The series a request would use and the text its next number would have (no lock, no allocation).

OpenFiscalYearRequest.description: Opens the fiscal year that starts in StartYear (on the calendar's start month) as `open` or `future`.

OutboxMessage.description: A stored outbox row as the dispatcher and the operator UI see it.

PageOfActivityView.description: One page of a list: the items and the opaque cursor of the next page (null on the last page).

PageOfDeliverySummary.description: One page of a list: the items and the opaque cursor of the next page (null on the last page).

PageOfItemSummary.description: One page of a list: the items and the opaque cursor of the next page (null on the last page).

PageOfJournalEntrySummary.description: One page of a list: the items and the opaque cursor of the next page (null on the last page).

PageOfManualJournalSummary.description: One page of a list: the items and the opaque cursor of the next page (null on the last page).

PageOfNotificationView.description: One page of a list: the items and the opaque cursor of the next page (null on the last page).

PageOfStockLedgerRow.description: One page of a list: the items and the opaque cursor of the next page (null on the last page).

PageOfStockSearchRow.description: One page of a list: the items and the opaque cursor of the next page (null on the last page).

PeriodGaps.description: Gapless audit for one reset period of a series: what was issued and which numbers are missing (expected: none).

PostingWindowRequest.description: One allow-posting window: for everyone when RoleId is null, else for that role; at least one bound.

RecordScopes.description: Record scopes attached to a principal's grants; an empty set for a scope type means "all".

RecurringLineRequest.description: A template line: amounts in fixed mode, percentages of the base amount in percentage mode (debit or credit side), accounts only in variable mode.

RoutineOutcome.description: One item the routine handled: what it targeted, what it produced, or why it waited.

RoutineRunResult.description: What one run of the daily routines did for a company (or a tenant when Guid? RoutineRunResult.CompanyId is null).

SaveItemUomRequest.description: 1 Uom = Numerator / Denominator base units (24 pieces per carton: 24/1; 1 piece = 1/24 carton is never stored, the inverse is derived).

SetCounterRequest.description: Moves a counter; moving it backwards needs the reset permission and a reason and never below a number already issued.

StockSearchRow.description: One row per item and warehouse for the global stock search: what is there, what is promised, what can be taken.

TenantSecurityPolicy.description: Security policy a tenant admin controls (stored in control.tenants.settings).

TransferQuantityRequest.description: A quantity for one line of a ship or receive, in the line's unit; lines left out take everything outstanding.

WebhookCreated.description: Returned once, at creation and rotation: the secret is stored encrypted and never shown again.
